notes.title: Demo Update March
notes.content:
Dear gamers,

I'm thrilled to express my heartfelt gratitude for your wishlists for Vivian and Kyuma!  As I march toward the big release day, I'm delighted to announce that new demo updates are now available.

Thank you once again.

While the story is still progressing, new scenes and gameplay features of Vivian's cultivation activity have been added to the demo.

[b]Point & Click[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/97cf951c9e61e295bce56d2ff6463c1c92d3d8fc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/0e26f7ccc7aa3285e2d00c752b21c59d8b976c55.png[/img][/url]

[b]Button Choices[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/6f8a046bbcfb5c8bef4ef604d48079814a7926d9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/2b0b48634c532e53a46a5dea004601731d82cce5.png[/img][/url]

and more...

I look forward to any feedback.

Warm regards,
Skylight Studio

notes.title: Demo for MacOS bug fixed
notes.content:
A bug has been fixed for the demo for MacOS support.
If you installed the demo for MacOS locally before Jan 29 and have problems launching the game, please reinstall with the latest version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/8b069c7d780695746cb38422234bd27fdb1cf7f8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: English Demo Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/73b2ba85e6c56c0413fcaf0227144f8425a42527.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday!

I'm very happy to announce the demo of Vivian and Kyuma is now available on Steam. Please, download it, try it out, and share your thoughts!

There are 200+ original artworks, 60+ short (~2 seconds) animations, tons of sound effects, and other fun pieces for you to explore. 

I look forward to the upcoming Steam Next Fest and share more with you about Vivian and Kyuma.

Cheers,
Skylight Studio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/802c863ee0df9f7fcc2d0caf8c5ef1384d1bf87b.png[/img]

notes.title: 2024 Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798277/87281c1dc0ceff248fa35e13ffac2a285b50cb8b.jpg[/img]

Hello!

Thank you all for your interest in Vivian and Kyuma. I'm working hard on launching the game in Q3 this year. As you might have known, 2024 is the Dragon year, followed by 2025 the Snake year. As a celebration, I can't wait to share this visual novel with you.

To gain early feedback, a demo is scheduled to be released by February 5.  I will keep the community posted on the progress.

Cheers,
Skylight Studio
